summary: Victim reported losing funds after sending crypto to a Telegram bot called “50 cal sniper sol” (@Fiftysniperbot) promoted in Telegram channels, which promised trading-related services but instead absconded with the funds.
user_mistake: Sent cryptocurrency to a Telegram trading bot promising returns
prevention: Avoid sending funds to Telegram bots or social media trading tools / Treat unsolicited trading bots as scams
